notes: Measured with drafts/content/tools/loot-per-run-sim.test.ts.keep: the smart bot, typical skill, 200 seeds (1-200), tier 1 stats {100 health, 10 power, 0 guard} on belt 1 and tier 3 stats {332.79, 45.85, 33.53} on belt 3, on main's content. Each number is how many of that enemy appear in the rooms one run actually plays (Dough Blob splits counted). Expected drops per run = sum(count x chance). check-loot-b3.py reads this file. emberDataSha256 is a hash of every Ember Kitchens room and the enemies they use, on main 56a079f (re-measured: counts identical). check-loot-b3.py recomputes it and fails with a 're-run the sim' message if the rooms or enemies change.
